name: The Elevator Game
source:
Alone in a hotel that isn’t quite real. Doors multiply. Stairs loop endlessly. The elevator might be your only way out – or a trap.

[From [url=https://whywhenwhowhat.itch.io/the-elevator-game-a-visual-novel]Itch.io[/url]]
